title: Evaluation of the canonical block tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer such that the number of free coordinates under $\rho$ is at most $k$. For every $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the canonical block tree constructed with fuel $k$ evaluates at $x$ to the value of $\varphi$ on the sign vector obtained by completing $\rho$ using $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
The number of free coordinates under $\rho$ is at most $k$
